cause: The immutable edge-data public readback failed during the TLS handshake with URLError wrapping ConnectionResetError. Git persistence and earlier application ingestion had succeeded; this was not an auth, quota, official-data, or ingestion failure.
resolution: PR #69 treats only URLError(ConnectionResetError) at public readback as a transient transport failure. The failed batch remains permanently excluded and is never replayed; the watcher waits five minutes and captures fresh observations. Auth, quota, ingestion, and unknown failures still stop.
verification: 130 tests passed; 1 skipped. Recovery, permanent failed-batch exclusion, auth/quota stopping, and ingestion stopping are covered.
constraints: 60-second sends, 1000/day requests, 60000ms/day CPU, 24-item batches and 315-minute run limit unchanged. No historical forecast backfill.
